subject: SIG questionnaire initiation & SOC 2/BAA info
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@novahealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation & SOC 2/BAA info

Hi Jason / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: NovaHealth is evaluating Redwood for the patient-data summarization pipeline (prod, will process PHI). You asked about SOC 2, GDPR/BAA coverage, and an estimate for SIG/CAIQ turnaround.
- Ask / next steps: I’m starting the vendor security questionnaire (SIG) on our side so we can parallelize responses — attached is the initiation packet. Marissa (cc’d) will handle the detailed security answers.

Quick answers to help triage:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security & availability) — audit report available under NDA.
- HIPAA/BAA: We support HIPAA-covered workloads and sign BAAs; I’ve included a DocuSign link to our standard BAA for your legal team.
- GDPR/Data Processing: We have a DPA and standard SCCs; we can provide the full DPA on request.
- Encryption: At-rest encryption with customer-managed KMS support (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK).

Action items for NovaHealth:
1) Please confirm the primary security contact for questionnaire follow-up (name + email).
2) Confirm scope: will Redwood process PHI in prod only, or also in staging/test environments?
3) Any preferred questionnaire format (SIG vs CAIQ vs bespoke)? We can complete SIG by default.

I attached: redwood_sig_initiation_form.pdf (short intake) — can you fill the highlighted scope fields and return? Marissa will follow up with the SIG spreadsheet and technical evidence.

Proposed timeline: If we get the intake back by EOD Fri (Aug 6) we can return a completed SIG draft by Aug 12 and schedule a tech review the week of Aug 17.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

—
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Camila — thanks for the summary and for starting the SIG. A few quick items from our side: 

- Primary security contact: Priya Shah (priya.shah@novahealth.com) — I’m cc’ing her here.
- Scope: We will be validating for prod PHI processing only initially; staging may be scoped later.
- Format: SIG is fine by us. If you can include CAIQ mappings later, that would be helpful but not required up front.

A couple of clarifying questions your team can answer in the SIG or now: 
1) Can you confirm whether you offer a customer-managed key (CMEK) option for token/model cache at-rest encryption, and if so which cloud KMS are supported?
2) Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report we can access under NDA? Our procurement will request that.
3) Any limitations on data residency / where inference is processed (we prefer us-east region)?

If you can send the intake back with those fields filled we’ll route to InfoSec and legal. Timeline: procurement would like the SIG back in ~7 business days if possible.

Thanks —
Jason Lee
Director of Integrations | NovaHealth
jason.lee@novahealth.com
(212) 555-0188

Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation & SOC 2/BAA info

Thanks Jason — answered inline below and attached the intake with scope filled where I could: redwood_sig_initiation_form.pdf (updated).

Answers: 
- CMEK/KMS: Yes, customer-managed keys are supported. We support AWS KMS (CMEK) and GCP CMEK configurations for encrypting persistent model caches and data at-rest. For hosted customers we also offer Redwood-managed keys; for Dedicated/Private we require CMEK if requested.
- SOC 2 Type II: We completed SOC 2 Type II (Security & Availability) in 2025. We can share the report under NDA — DocuSign / evidence link below.
- Regions/data residency: Redwood routes inference by region; we can pin workloads to us-east-1 for NovaHealth. For Private deployments we can target on-prem or a customer VPC.

I’ve attached a link to our standard BAA/DPA flow (redwood_baa_dpa_link.txt) and included a proposed timeline: return intake by Aug 6 -> SIG draft by Aug 12 -> tech review week of Aug 17. Marissa will pick up the SIG spreadsheet and technical evidence items (screenshots, config docs, encryption proofs).

Would you prefer a short 30-min tech review with Marissa next week (I can coordinate calendar invites)?

—
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Jason / Priya — Marissa here (security). Picking up from Camila with the SIG work. I attached our working SIG/CAIQ answers (redwood_sig_answers_v1.xlsx). A few notes and requests: 

- PHI handling: Confirmed — we recommend scoping only prod for the initial assessment. For PHI we surface the BAA and outline our access controls.
- Evidence: Included screenshots for KMS key configuration and example encryption config for S3-backed model caches. For the SOC 2 report we can share a redacted copy once an NDA is in place; please send your standard NDA or we can use our secure evidence portal (link above).
- Open Qs I’ll need from NovaHealth: 
  * Which specific API endpoints will you call (chat/generation/embeddings)?
  * Expected QPS and average request size (tokens) — this helps us size telemetry and log retention windows.

We should aim to have a completed SIG draft for your InfoSec by Aug 12 if NovaHealth can return the intake and the two bullets above by EOD Aug 6. If it helps, I’m available for a 30-min technical call Wed Aug 12 or Thu Aug 13 (PST).

Thanks — I’ll update the sheet with additional evidence links and mark items that require vendor-uploaded evidence.

Best,
Marissa Cole
